description: Create one or more content templates for the brand. Pass a single template object, or pass the 'templates' array param for bulk creation. If both are supplied, 'templates' (bulk) takes precedence. Returns the created template record(s).

body.description: Template body with placeholders, e.g. '[HOOK] … [CTA]' (required for single creation).

example.description: An example post filled in using this template.

isFavorite.description: Mark as favorite to surface it first in template lists.

pattern.description: The rhetorical or structural pattern described in plain language.

platforms.description: Platforms this template is best suited for (e.g. ['x', 'linkedin']).

templates.description: Bulk-create multiple templates in one call. Overrides the single-template fields when present.

name: template_create
